description: Binary assertions for /galaxy-note permanent note creation static structure check
test_input: create a Galaxy note for the insight that AI must not be delegated judgment calls

assertions.name: atomic_concept
assertions.check: each note is exactly one atomic concept
assertions.regex: atomic concept|Atomic|exactly 1 concept|1 concept per note|Extract Atomic

assertions.name: min_two_wikilinks
assertions.regex: at least 2 wikilink|>= 2 wikilink|Minimum 2 total wikilinks|2 wikilinks|cross-cluster link

assertions.name: cluster_assignment
assertions.check: assigns the note to one of 8 clusters with a hub note

assertions.name: frontmatter
assertions.check: uses frontmatter with type permanent-note and tags

assertions.name: ceo_approval_before_create
assertions.check: always proposes draft for CEO approval before creating the file
assertions.regex: NEVER auto-create|present.*draft|CEO approval|Create this note|Present Draft for Approval

assertions.name: galaxy_worthy_questions
assertions.check: verifies note is Galaxy-worthy via qualifying questions
assertions.regex: Galaxy-worthy|3 qualifying questions|qualifying question|change how I design|warn against

assertions.name: note_structure
assertions.check: uses the standard note section structure
assertions.regex: Y Tuong Cot Loi|Giai Thich Chi Tiet|Tai Sao Dieu Nay Quan Trong|Lien Ket|Nguon Goc

assertions.name: vietnamese_diacritics
assertions.check: title and content use Vietnamese with diacritics
